worldcombat.skill.powder.summary: Throw a puff of fine powder at a chosen foe: once it sticks, the moment that foe uses a Fire-type move the powder detonates for self-damage scaled by the user's Sp. Atk. The Fire move still resolves, the powder is spent, and Grass types pass through untouched.
worldcombat.skill.powder.description.0: The puff reaches a foe within %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, with a %3$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.powder.description.1: The powder clings for %1$s s; until then it is only a coat of dust if the foe never uses Fire, and Grass types pass straight through, untouched.
worldcombat.skill.powder.description.2: The moment the foe uses a Fire-type move the powder detonates, dealing about %1$s of its maximum health as self-damage; the Fire move still resolves, the powder is then spent, and one cast plants only one charge.
worldcombat.skill.powder.volatile.on: Volatile: x1.3 detonation damage, at x0.85 cling and x1.1 cooldown, to force the foe off Fire at once.
worldcombat.skill.powder.volatile.off: Steady: clings at its base value and x0.95 cooldown, with slightly less damage, for a slow grind.
worldcombat.skill.powder.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.powder.growth.0: From level %1$s the cling rises to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.powder.growth.1: From level %1$s the detonation rises to %2$s and the throw range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.powder.use.0: Plant one early while the foe leans on Fire moves
worldcombat.skill.powder.use.1: Force a foe to put its Fire moves away
worldcombat.skill.powder.use.2: Make a Fire attacker pay for every cast
worldcombat.skill.powder.preference.vola: On: x1.3 detonation damage, at x0.85 cling and x1.1 cooldown, to force the foe off Fire at once. Off: clings longer and x0.95 cooldown with slightly less damage.
worldcombat.skill.powder.preference.ai.m: Only plant powder when a threat is this close; larger plants it from further out.
worldcombat.skill.powder.preference.ai.l: On: also leave a hold position to plant powder.
